Resample tracking data using Continuous-Time Movement Models (CTMM)

Source: R/resample.ctmm.R
resample.ctmm.Rd

Fits continuous-time movement models to individual tracking data and predicts locations at regular time intervals. It handles coordinate reprojection, model selection, and retains static individual traits.

Usage

resample.ctmm(
  dat,
  tint,
  ids = "ID",
  timestamp = "timestamp",
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  proj.in,
  proj.out = proj.in,
  static.cols = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

dat

A data.frame containing the tracking data.

tint

Numeric. The desired time interval for resampling, in seconds.

ids

Character. The name of the column containing individual identifiers. Default is "ID".

timestamp

Character. The name of the column containing timestamps. Default is "timestamp".

x

Character. The name of the column containing the X coordinate or Longitude. Default is "x".

y

Character. The name of the column containing the Y coordinate or Latitude. Default is "y".

proj.in

An object of class crs (from sf), an EPSG code, or a PROJ4 string representing the input coordinate reference system.

proj.out

An object of class crs (from sf), an EPSG code, or a PROJ4 string representing the output coordinate reference system. Must be in meters. Defaults to proj.in.

static.cols

Character vector. Optional names of columns containing static individual information (e.g., sex, species) to append to the resampled dataset. Default is NULL.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints progress and model summaries to the console. Default is TRUE.

Value

A data.frame with the resampled trajectories, including predicted X and Y coordinates, time in POSIXct format, time in numeric seconds, and any specified static columns.

Examples

# \donttest{
# Regularise the first 150 fixes of one individual to hourly locations
trk <- sim_tracks[sim_tracks$ID == "F02", ][1:150, ]
reg <- resample.ctmm(trk, tint = 3600, ids = "ID", timestamp = "timestamp",
                     proj.in = 25830, static.cols = "sex", verbose = FALSE)
#> Minimum sampling interval of 51.4 minutes in unknown
head(reg)
#>         ID        x       y                time     time_s    sex
#> 1056   F02 421007.4 4332970 2024-03-01 11:56:18 1709294178 female
#> 1056.1 F02 421003.0 4332981 2024-03-01 12:56:18 1709297778 female
#> 1056.2 F02 420998.6 4332980 2024-03-01 13:56:18 1709301378 female
#> 1056.3 F02 420984.0 4332982 2024-03-01 14:56:18 1709304978 female
#> 1056.4 F02 420977.1 4332973 2024-03-01 15:56:18 1709308578 female
#> 1056.5 F02 420937.5 4332964 2024-03-01 16:56:18 1709312178 female
# }
